ARCHITECTURAL_INCONSISTENCY_DOCUMENTED.description: Stage 1 vs Stage 2 capability gap is by design
ARCHITECTURAL_INCONSISTENCY_DOCUMENTED.explanation: Stage 2 detect_candidates() uses full trajectory including PREDICTED to maximize recall at kinematic level. Stage 1 measures grounded track quality, which is an independent diagnostic for tracker performance, not a Stage 2 gate.
ARCHITECTURAL_INCONSISTENCY_DOCUMENTED.implication: Some events detected at Stage 2+ have no Stage 1 grounded support — they rely on Kalman-predicted positions only. This is the correct explanation for FP events in video_10 post-rally.
